searched: grep for pyyaml in uv.lock and pyproject.toml files (present only as a transitive entry in daemon/uv.lock and cli/uv.lock)

findings.summary: The test imports yaml, but PyYAML is not declared in daemon/pyproject.toml. It resolves only as a transitive entry in daemon/uv.lock (the lock lists pyyaml as a dependency of another package). If an upstream package drops it, collection fails with ImportError, and the gate reads that as a daemon test failure rather than a dependabot-config failure. The mypy override added at daemon/pyproject.toml line 103 widens the unchecked-import list to hide the missing stubs, so nothing flags the undeclared dependency. The tests themselves are sound: they assert the group, schedule, directories and allow list, and would go red if the allow list or group wiring changed. Fix would be declaring pyyaml in the daemon dev dependency group. I did not read the verified journal records or verify.sh, and I did not run the tests.
